compensation_office.name: Caisse de compensation du canton du Valais

registration.how: With the compensation office's PDF form from avsvalais.ch: fill it in, sign it and send it by post.
registration.deadline: Within one month of the start of work, register with the **compensation office of your canton of residence** (simplified or ordinary procedure).

simplified_procedure.explanation: Under the simplified procedure you settle AHV/IV/EO, unemployment insurance and a 5 % withholding tax once a year through the compensation office (Caisse de compensation du canton du Valais). It is optional and applies up to CHF 22'680 of annual wage per person. Accident insurance (UVG) is only included if you choose the plus option when you register. Otherwise you take it out yourself with an insurer.

family_allowances.explanation: Child allowance: CHF 327 per child a month. Training allowance: CHF 477 a month. Plus a one-off birth allowance of CHF 2'142. As of 2026.

minimum_wage.explanation: There is no cantonal minimum wage in Valais. The minimum wage of the federal NAV for household work is binding: CHF 20.35 an hour unskilled, CHF 22.30 with 4 years' experience or an EBA, CHF 24.55 with an EFZ. It applies from 5 hours a week with the same household.

sick_pay.legal_basis: Arrêté CTT économie domestique VS (RS 221.602), art. 17

exemptions: The parties may agree otherwise in writing.
sickness_insurance_ktg.legal_basis: Arrêté CTT économie domestique VS (RS 221.602), art. 17

cantons.withholding_tax: In the simplified procedure, yes, for every employee: 5 % withholding tax, whatever the nationality or permit, Swiss nationals and C permit holders included. Caisse de compensation du canton du Valais settles it together with the contributions. In the ordinary procedure, withholding tax applies only without a C permit (for example B, L or G), at the ordinary tariff.
cantons.childcare_tax_deduction: Yes. In Valais, up to CHF 10'000 per child a year (cantonal and municipal tax), and up to CHF 25'800 for federal tax (2026). Condition: the child is under 14 and both parents work or are in training.
cantons.penalty_without_registration: An employer who does not join a compensation office and settle the wages commits an offence under the AHV Act: a monetary penalty of up to 180 daily units (Art. 87 AHVG). On top come the social insurance contributions, as a rule back-dated up to 5 years.
